listcmp_int::ret_elem_as_int.note: WASM path correctly REFUSES `def f(fs: list[float]) -> int: return fs[0]` (r5 return-slot representability rule: a float value cannot be represented in the int return slot without truncation; function stays JS). The js/glue RED is NOT a WASM bug: it fires only for integer-valued floats ([1.0], not [2.5]) and is the int/float #451-class representation gap (a JS number 1.0 is indistinguishable from int 1, while CPython keeps the float). OUT of #485/#487 scope.

listcmp_int::call_arg_float_into_int.note: WASM path correctly REFUSES passing a float into an int parameter (`callee_int(fs[0])`, r5 call-argument-slot rule: the call converts nothing, so the static types must match; caller stays JS, callee stays admitted). The js/glue RED is the same int/float #451-class representation gap plus the JS backend not coercing at the call boundary. OUT of #485/#487 scope.

Already refused at #491's base commit de345491 (verified with the base binary: evidence/wasm_net-base-de345491.txt) - the pin recorded the pre-#496 RED. Re-pinned surgically during #491; the arity_int0/float0 js+glue arms likewise turned green before #491 and are re-pinned here.

stmts::math_sqrt.note: NEW-W6 `math.sqrt(-1.0)` -> nan on WASM AND JS where CPython raises ValueError (math domain)

stmts::math_floor.note: NEW-W7 `math.floor(inf/nan)` -> no OverflowError/ValueError on JS; the js+wasm GLUE's JS twin throws ReferenceError because the glue never imports the stdlib `math` module it embeds (js/glue RED). Since r5 the WASM direct arm correctly REFUSES this function (return-slot rule: `math.floor(...)` is typed F64 and cannot be represented in the `-> int` slot without truncation; it stays JS, where it is correct for finite floats). The js/glue REDs are the pre-existing NEW-W7 stdlib-math gap, out of #485/#487 scope.
